description: List the brands (usually competitors) this company watches, newest watch first. Each has a status: available (its emails are in the gallery; emailCount and latestEmailAt say how many and how recent), requested (not in the gallery yet), collecting (added, emails on the way) or declined (with declineReason). Use list_watched_brand_emails to read what they sent. Requires templates:read.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: list_watched_brands

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_watched_brands` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

limit.description: How many watches and brand requests a company can keep together.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

watchlist.description: Watched brands, newest watch first: id, domain, note, status (available, requested, collecting or declined), declineReason, watchedAt, emailCount, latestEmailAt (when its newest gallery email was sent) and brand (name, slug and url, once its emails are in the gallery).

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
